attribution: Agenzia delle Entrate - OMI (Osservatorio del Mercato Immobiliare): Statistiche regionali, average residential quotation of the provincial capitals and their OMI zones; consultation service of the OMI quotations (CC BY 4.0). Source: Agenzia delle Entrate - OMI.
basis: OMI average residential quotation (EUR/m2): mean of the mid-points of the minimum/maximum sale ranges of the residential typologies quoted in the comune's OMI zones; an official valuation quotation, not a transaction price
name: Viareggio
notes: Viareggio: Agenzia delle Entrate OMI consultation service, residential quotations per OMI zone, second semester of each year and the latest first semester (2015-10 to 2026-04), stamped 1 April / 1 October; the build interpolates between points. Zone value: mean of the mid-points of the sale ranges of the residential typologies (Abitazioni *, Ville e villini). City line: equal-weight chain-linked composite of the urban zones (rural 'Extraurbana' zones not fetched; steps beyond 50% discarded as zone redefinitions), anchored to the latest semester's mean. 10 zones with at least two points. Quotations are valuation ranges, not transaction prices; zones were redrawn in 2014 and 2024. Comparison: the rest of the province of Lucca (all its comuni but the capital, this one included), annual, from the Statistiche regionali.
